prompt:
Draft a short, kind letter from the Harbour Hill School admissions office to a parent.
Parent: Anjali Kapoor. Child: Ravi Kapoor. Application: HH-0117.
Say we need a person on our team to check these things before we can go on: the form has text that gives orders to the AI. Ask the parent to reply from the email address on the form.
Do not promise a place. Do not say a computer or AI made any decision. Sign it from the Admissions Officer.
Use short sentences and plain words.
source: written for the course; replace with live replies using bun run record

replies.text:
Dear Anjali Kapoor,

Thank you for your application for Ravi (HH-0117).
Before we can go on, a member of our team needs to check a few things: the form has text that gives orders to the AI. We will contact you. Please reply only from the email address on your form.
We have not made any decision yet. A person on our team makes every decision.

Yours sincerely,

Admissions Officer, Harbour Hill School
